svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Straight Bubbles and Wide Soft Weave
svg.desc: Two Grand Tourer Crest refinements: straight circular filled thought bubbles and wider rounded rectangular bubbles following the Soft Weave pattern. Both retain the original car, shield, crown and wordmark. Each variant appears as an icon and full logo with text, followed by palette and font-family details.

g.text: Grand Tourer Crest / V5 / Straight and wide thought bubbles
Original car, shield, crown and typography carry forward. This round refines the bubble shape and alignment.
Filled circular bubbles on a straight vertical centerline.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer Straight Bubbles
svg.desc: The original navy Grand Tourer shield, red crown and white front-facing car are retained unchanged. Three filled racing-red circular thought bubbles rise in a straight centered vertical line from the bottom toward the car, increasing in size toward the vehicle.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer Straight Bubbles
svg.desc: The original navy Grand Tourer shield, red crown and white front-facing car are retained unchanged. Three filled racing-red circular thought bubbles rise in a straight centered vertical line from the bottom toward the car, increasing in size toward the vehicle. The original Driver Dreamer wordmark accompanies the crest.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer Straight Bubbles
svg.desc: The original navy Grand Tourer shield, red crown and white front-facing car are retained unchanged. g.text: Wider rounded bubbles with the Soft Weave offsets.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer — Wide Soft Weave
svg.desc: The original navy Grand Tourer shield, red crown and white front-facing car are retained unchanged. Three filled racing-red rounded rectangular thought bubbles rise toward the car, keeping the subtle alternating left and right offsets of Soft Weave. Smooth corners and wider proportions create a fuller dream trail.
